OmopMultistate: Multi-State Analyses Using the OMOP Common Data Model

Source: R/OmopMultistate-package.R
OmopMultistate-package.Rd

Prepare cohort records from the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership (OMOP) Common Data Model for multi-state analyses. Define permitted transitions between cohort-defined states, estimate state occupation probabilities overall and across strata, and visualise the results. Analyses use the 'survival' and 'mstate' packages and return standard 'omopgenerics' summarised results.

Details

Start with a cohort table containing one cohort per state and use transMat() to define the permitted transitions. Prepare data for other models with prepareMultistateData(), or estimate state occupation probabilities with summariseMultistateProbabilities(). Use tidy() and settings() to inspect results and plotMultistateProbabilities() to plot them.
